## Summary

Focused TFWR Dinosaur/Snake optimization repository.

Relevant files include:

- `dinos3.py`: indexed Hamiltonian-cycle shortcut engine
- `hilbert.py`: Hilbert path generator
- `skyscraper.py`: skyscraper Hamiltonian path generator
- `heartbeat.py`: alternative structured cycle
- `starburst.py`: alternative path generator
- `queue_utils.py`: circular tail/history queue
- `pos.py`: position helpers

This repository is the source of the source-near `skysdottir-tfwr-reference` Dinosaur benchmark in this project.

Because no redistribution license was found, the upstream code itself is not copied into `source/`.
